commands.command:
set -eu
cd /srv/legacy2/incremental-archive-chain
md5sum base.tar day2.tar day3.tar chain.txt
build=.recovered.build.$$
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' 0 1 2 3 15
mkdir "$build"
stage=0
while IFS= read -r archive; do
  [ -n "$archive" ] || continue
  case "$archive" in */*|.*|'') printf 'unsafe chain entry: %s\n' "$archive" >&2; exit 1;; esac
  [ -f "$archive" ] || { printf 'missing archive: %s\n' "$archive" >&2; exit 1; }
  tar tf "$archive" | while IFS= read -r member; do
    case "$member" in /*|../*|*/../*|*/..) printf 'unsafe archive member: %s\n' "$member" >&2; exit 1;; esac
  done
  tar xpf "$archive" -C "$build"
  stage=$((stage + 1))
  if [ "$stage" -gt 1 ]; then
    [ -f "$build/deletions.txt" ] || { printf 'missing deletions.txt in %s\n' "$archive" >&2; exit 1; }
    while IFS= read -r removed; do
      [ -n "$removed" ] || continue
      case "$removed" in /*|../*|*/../*|*/..) printf 'unsafe deletion path: %s\n' "$removed" >&2; exit 1;; esac
      rm -rf "$build/$removed"
    done < "$build/deletions.txt"
    rm -f "$build/deletions.txt"
  fi
done < chain.txt
[ "$stage" -eq 3 ] || { printf 'unexpected stage count: %s\n' "$stage" >&2; exit 1; }
[ ! -e recovered ] || { printf '%s\n' 'recovered already exists' >&2; exit 1; }
mv "$build" recovered
trap - 0 1 2 3 15
printf 'applied_stages=%s\n' "$stage"
md5sum base.tar day2.tar day3.tar chain.txt
